content: function validatePassword($password) {     if (strlen($password) < 8) return 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractères';     if (!preg_match('/[0-9]/', $password)) return 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins un chiffre';     if (!preg_match('/[A-Z]/', $password)) return 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins une majuscule';     if (!preg_match('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', $password)) return 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins un caractère spécial';     return null; }

name: generateJWT
content: function generateJWT($user) {     $header = json_encode(['alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'JWT']);     $payload = json_encode([         'sub' => $user['id'],         'email' => $user['email'],         'nom' => $user['nom'],         'role' => $user['role'],         'iat' => time(),         'exp' => time() + JWT_EXPIRY,     ]);          $headerEncoded = base64UrlEncode($header);     $payloadEncoded = base64UrlEncode($payload);     $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $headerEncoded . '.' . $payloadEncoded, JWT_SECRET, true);     $signatureEncoded = base64UrlEncode($signature);          return $headerEncoded . '.' . $payloadEncoded . '.' . $signatureEncoded; }

name: verifyJWT
content: function verifyJWT($token) {     $parts = explode('.', $token);     if (count($parts) !== 3) return false;          $headerEncoded = $parts[0];     $payloadEncoded = $parts[1];     $signatureEncoded = $parts[2];          $expectedSignature = hash_hmac('sha256', $headerEncoded . '.' . $payloadEncoded, JWT_SECRET, true);     $expectedSignatureEncoded = base64UrlEncode($expectedSignature);          if (!hash_equals($expectedSignatureEncoded, $signatureEncoded)) return false;          $payload = json_decode(base64UrlDecode($payloadEncoded), true);     if (!$payload) return false;     if (isset($payload['exp']) && $payload['exp'] < time()) return false;          return $payload; }

name: base64UrlEncode
content: function base64UrlEncode($data) {     return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($data), '+/', '-_'), '='); }

name: base64UrlDecode
content: function base64UrlDecode($data) {     $padding = strlen($data) % 4;     if ($padding) $data .= str_repeat('=', 4 - $padding);     return base64_decode(strtr($data, '-_', '+/')); }

name: getAuthHeader
content: function getAuthHeader() {     // Priorité absolue au cookie HttpOnly (Sécurité maximale)     if (!empty($_COOKIE['auth_token'])) {         return $_COOKIE['auth_token'];     }     // Token retiré — plus aucun token en paramètre GET/POST/REQUEST     // Le token doit impérativement être transmis via le cookie HttpOnly     return null;     // PHP-FPM/CGI : $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']     if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])) {         return str_replace('Bearer ', '', $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']);     }     // Apache mod_php : getallheaders()     if (function_exists('getallheaders')) {         $headers = getallheaders();         $headers = array_change_key_case($headers, CASE_LOWER);         if (!empty($headers['authorization'])) {             return str_replace('Bearer ', '', $headers['authorization']);         }         if (!empty($headers['x-authorization'])) {             return str_replace('Bearer ', '', $headers['x-authorization']);         }     }     // REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION (OVH/Apache)     if (!empty($_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])) {         return str_replace('Bearer ', '', $_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']);     }     // X-Authorization via $_SERVER (fallback OVH)     if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_AUTHORIZATION'])) {         return str_replace('Bearer ', '', $_SERVER['HTTP_X_AUTHORIZATION']);     }     return null; }

name: paginate
content: function paginate($db, $baseSql, $params = [], $countColumn = '*') {     $page = max(1, (int)($_GET['page'] ?? 1));     $perPage = min(100, max(1, (int)($_GET['perPage'] ?? 100)));     // Compter le total     $countSql = preg_replace('/SELECT .* FROM/i', "SELECT COUNT($countColumn) FROM", $baseSql);     $countStmt = $db->prepare($countSql);     $countStmt->execute($params);     $total = (int)$countStmt->fetchColumn();     // Requête paginée     $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;     $sql = "$baseSql LIMIT $perPage OFFSET $offset";     $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);     $stmt->execute($params);     $data = $stmt->fetchAll();     return [         'data' => $data,         'total' => $total,         'page' => $page,         'perPage' => $perPage,     ]; }

'']);                 sendResponse(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Catégorie créée', 'id' => $id], 201);             } catch (PDOException $e) {                 if (strpos($e->getMessage(), 'UNIQUE') !== false) {                     sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Cette catégorie existe déjà'], 400);                 }                 throw $e;             }             break;                      case 'update':             $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);             if (empty($input['id']) || empty($input['nom'])) {                 sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'ID et nom requis'], 400);             }                          $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE stock_categories SET nom = ?, description = ? WHERE id = ?");             $stmt->execute([$input['nom'], $input['description'] ?? '', $input['id']]);                          sendResponse(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Catégorie modifiée']);             break;                      case 'delete':             $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);             $id = $input['id'] ?? '';                          $check = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM stock_articles WHERE categorie_id = ?");             $check->execute([$id]);             if ($check->fetch()['cnt'] > 0) {                 sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Des articles utilisent cette catégorie'], 400);             }                          $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_categories WHERE id = ?");             $stmt->execute([$id]);                          sendResponse(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Catégorie supprimée']);             break;                      default:             sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Action invalide'], 400);     } }

'';                          $sql = "SELECT m.*, a.nom as article_nom FROM stock_mouvements m JOIN stock_articles a ON m.article_id = a.id WHERE 1=1";             $params = [];                          if ($articleId) {                 $sql .= " AND m.article_id = ?";                 $params[] = $articleId;             }                          $sql .= " ORDER by m.date DESC";             $result = paginate($db, $sql, $params);             sendResponse(['success' => true] + $result);             break;                      case 'create':             $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);             if (empty($input['article_id']) || empty($input['type']) || empty($input['quantite'])) {                 sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Champs requis manquants'], 400);             }                          if (!in_array($input['type'], ['entree', 'sortie'])) {                 sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Type de mouvement invalide'], 400);             }                          $db->beginTransaction();                          try {                 $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT quantite FROM stock_articles WHERE id = ?");                 $stmt->execute([$input['article_id']]);                 $article = $stmt->fetch();                                  if (!$article) {                     throw new Exception('Article non trouvé');                 }                                  $newQty = $article['quantite'];                 if ($input['type'] === 'entree') {                     $newQty += $input['quantite'];                 } else {                     $newQty -= $input['quantite'];                     if ($newQty < 0) {                         throw new Exception('Stock insuffisant');                     }                 }                                  $id = $input['id'] ?? '',                     $input['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d')                 ]);                                  $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE stock_articles SET quantite = ? '';                          $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM stock_mouvements WHERE id = ?");             $stmt->execute([$id]);             $mvt = $stmt->fetch();                          if ($mvt) {                 $db->beginTransaction();                 try {                     $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT quantite FROM stock_articles WHERE id = ?");                     $stmt->execute([$mvt['article_id']]);                     $article = $stmt->fetch();                                          $newQty = $article['quantite'];                     if ($mvt['type'] === 'entree') {                         $newQty -= $mvt['quantite'];                     } else {                         $newQty += $mvt['quantite'];                     }                                          $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE stock_articles SET quantite = ? WHERE id = ?");                     $stmt->execute([$newQty, $mvt['article_id']]);                                          $stmt = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_mouvements WHERE id = ?");                     $stmt->execute([$id]);                                          $db->commit();                 } catch (Exception $e) {                     $db->rollBack();                     sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()], 400);                 }             }                          sendResponse(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Mouvement supprimé']);             break;                      default:             sendResponse(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Action invalide'], 400);     } }

content: export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {   const [user, setUser] = useState<Utilisateur | null>(null);   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);   useEffect(() => {     verifyToken();   }, []);   async function verifyToken() {     try {       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth.php?action=verify`, {         credentials: 'include',       });       const data = await res.json();       if (data.success) {         setUser(data.user);       }     } catch {       // Non connecté     }     setLoading(false);   }   async function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {     try {       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth.php?action=login`, {         method: 'POST',         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },         body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),         credentials: 'include',       });       const data = await res.json();       if (data.success) {         setUser(data.user);         setToken(data.token);         return { success: true };       }       return { success: false, error: data.error };     } catch {       return { success: false, error: 'Impossible de contacter le serveur' };     }   }   function logout() {     setUser(null);     setToken(null);   }   return (     <AuthContext.Provider value={{       isAuthenticated: !!user,       user,       token,       login,       logout,       loading     }}>       {children}     </AuthContext.Provider>   ); }

content: function normalizeAnniversaire(val: string | undefined): string {   if (!val) return '';   if (val.length === 5 && val.includes('-')) return val; // MM-DD   if (val.length === 10 && val.includes('-')) return val.slice(5); // YYYY-MM-DD → MM-DD   return ''; }

name: getMonthDay
content: function getMonthDay(val: string | undefined): { month: number; day: number } | null {   const norm = normalizeAnniversaire(val);   if (!norm) return null;   const [m, d] = norm.split('-').map(Number);   if (!m || !d || m < 1 || m > 12 || d < 1 || d > 31) return null;   return { month: m, day: d }; }

name: formatAnniversaire
content: function formatAnniversaire(val: string | undefined): string {   const md = getMonthDay(val);   if (!md) return '';   return `${String(md.day).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(md.month).padStart(2, '0')}`; }

name: isBirthdayOnDate
content: export function isBirthdayOnDate(val: string | undefined, target: Date): boolean {   const md = getMonthDay(val);   if (!md) return false;   return md.month - 1 === getMonth(target) && md.day === getDate(target); }
